title: G-Tree: Ancestors with a Changing Root

requirements.text: Determine ancestry using the path from the current root.
Treat each node as its own ancestor, including singleton trees.
Persist logical root changes without changing the given edges.
Accept arbitrary initial edge order and print only ordered query answers.

time_by_phase.Whole input: O(N log N + Q log N)

reference_complexity.notes: Reference uses iterative traversal, one original-root index, and binary lifting. Retained input/output and recursion count toward total program space. These are reference targets, not inferred bounds for submitted code. Hard/60 minutes and limits are provisional.
